3 Days Gorilla Trekking Safari in Rwanda

Package overview

Experience one of Africa’s most unforgettable wildlife encounters with this 3-day gorilla trekking safari in . This short yet immersive journey takes you to the renowned , home to the endangered mountain gorillas. Along the way, enjoy scenic landscapes, rich culture, and the thrill of coming face-to-face with these gentle giants.

  • Gorilla trekking in Volcanoes National Park
  • Scenic drive through Rwanda’s countryside
  • Cultural interaction at Iby’Iwacu Cultural Village
  • Kigali city tour and historical experience
  • Guided gorilla trekking
  • Incredible photography opportunities

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Arrival in Kigali – Transfer to Volcanoes National Park

Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport , you will be met by your driver-guide for a short briefing about your safari. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy a brief city tour of Kigali , including a visit to the Kigali Genocide Memorial for historical insight. After lunch, depart for Volcanoes National Park , located in the Virunga Mountains. The drive offers breathtaking views of Rwanda’s rolling hills—often referred to as the “Land of a Thousand Hills.” Dinner and overnight at your lodge near the park.

02Day 2 | Gorilla Trekking Experience

After an early breakfast, head to the park headquarters for registration and a briefing by park rangers. You will then embark on a guided trek into the forest in search of a habituated gorilla family. Trekking can take anywhere from 2 to 6 hours depending on the location of the gorillas. Once located, you’ll spend a magical hour observing them—watching their interactions, feeding habits, and social behavior. This is a once-in-a-lifetime wildlife experience. Return to the lodge for relaxation after the trek. Optional activities (afternoon): Visit to the Iby’Iwacu Cultural Village Nature walks or community visits Dinner and overnight at the lodge.

03Day 3 | Return to Kigali – Departure

After breakfast, check out and drive back to Kigali . Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time for: Local market shopping Coffee experience or lunch in the city Transfer to Kigali International Airport for your departure flight. Gorilla Trekking Information Gorilla permits are required and should be booked in advance Minimum age: 15 years Fitness level: Moderate (trekking can be challenging but rewarding)
